title: Immortal’s takeover & Sting’s resistance
summary: The mystery of “They” ends with Jeff Hardy joining Hulk Hogan and Eric Bischoff in a takeover. Sting fights to remove Immortal from power and persuade Hogan to turn against the faction.

chapters.title: Jeff Hardy joins “They”
chapters.result: Hardy wins the world-title three-way and aligns with Hogan, Bischoff, Jarrett and Abyss.
chapters.context: The apparent fan favorite reveals his allegiance at the end of the main event. Immortal’s formation reframes the preceding mystery as an on-screen power grab.

chapters.title: Sting wins back control
chapters.result: Sting defeats Hogan, restoring Dixie Carter’s control under the stipulation.
chapters.context: When Immortal attacks Sting after the match, Hogan comes to his aid. The takeover story pays off with Hogan finally rejecting Bischoff’s side.
